items.exampleEn: The long wait at the airport was trying for everyone.
items.exampleZh: 在機場漫長的等待讓每個人都很煎熬。

items.exampleEn: His daydream of opening a café finally came true.
items.exampleZh: 他開咖啡館的白日夢終於實現了。

items.exampleEn: The exhilaration of winning the race lasted for days.
items.exampleZh: 贏得比賽的興奮之情持續了好幾天。

items.exampleEn: The children ate their pizza with gusto.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們津津有味地吃著披薩。

items.exampleEn: The walkers went astray in the fog and had to call for help.
items.exampleZh: 健行的人在霧中迷了路，只好打電話求救。

items.exampleEn: The team gave a lackluster performance in the final.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍在決賽中表現平平。
items.glossZh: 平淡無奇的；缺乏光彩的

items.exampleEn: Most scientists agree that fish are sentient beings.
items.exampleZh: 大多數科學家都同意，魚是有感知能力的生物。
items.glossZh: 有知覺的；有感知能力的

items.exampleEn: Irate drivers honked at the slow bus.
items.exampleZh: 憤怒的駕駛們對著那輛慢吞吞的公車按喇叭。

items.sentenceEn: An irate neighbor knocked on our door at midnight because of the noise.
items.sentenceZh: 一位氣沖沖的鄰居因為噪音，半夜來敲我們的門。

items.audioEn: Looking after three sick children at once made it a very trying weekend for Ben.
items.audioZh: 同時照顧三個生病的孩子，讓 Ben 度過了一個非常難熬的週末。
items.questionZh: Ben 的週末為什麼很難熬？
options: He looked after three sick children.

items.sentenceEn: We screamed with exhilaration as the ride dropped toward the ground.
items.sentenceZh: 遊樂設施往地面衝下去時，我們興奮地尖叫。

items.sentenceEn: Some people believe that robots will one day be sentient.
items.sentenceZh: 有些人相信，機器人總有一天會擁有知覺。

items.stemEn: Despite its famous cast, the film had a ____ story, and few people went to see it.
items.stemZh: 儘管卡司陣容堅強，這部電影的故事卻平淡無奇，沒什麼人去看。

items.stemEn: Our luggage went ____ during the change of flights and arrived two days later.
items.stemZh: 我們的行李在轉機時弄丟了，兩天後才送到。

items.passageEn: It had been a trying week for Mia, who works at a customer service center. On Monday, an irate customer shouted at her for twenty minutes because his parcel had gone astray. On Wednesday, the company's new answering program gave strange replies, and a colleague joked that it had become sentient. Mia spent most of Thursday in a daydream about her weekend plans. On Saturday, she finally went up in a hot-air balloon for the first time. As she rose above the hills, she felt pure exhilaration and a new sense of vitality. That evening, after a rather lackluster dinner at a hotel, she and her friends sang karaoke with great gusto until midnight.
items.passageZh: 對在客服中心上班的 Mia 來說，這是難熬的一週。星期一，一位憤怒的客人因為包裹寄丟了，對她吼了二十分鐘。星期三，公司新的自動回覆程式答非所問，一位同事開玩笑說它有了知覺。星期四，Mia 大半天都在對週末計畫做白日夢。星期六，她終於第一次搭上熱氣球。當她升到山丘上空時，感到無比興奮，也重新充滿了活力。那天晚上，在飯店吃了一頓相當平淡的晚餐後，她和朋友們興致勃勃地唱卡拉 OK 唱到半夜。

questions.questionZh: 星期一那位客人為什麼生氣？
options: 電話等了很久才有人接

questions.questionZh: Mia 星期六晚上做了什麼？
options: 在飯店吃了一頓很豐盛的大餐
回家準備下週的工作報告

items.promptZh: 上課的時候別再做白日夢了，專心聽老師說。
referenceEn: Stop daydreaming in class and listen to the teacher.
Don't daydream during class anymore; listen to your teacher.
rubricZh: 「做白日夢」用動詞 daydream（例如 stop daydreaming、don't daydream）
「專心聽老師說」可寫，例如 listen to the teacher、pay attention to the teacher 等

items.instructionZh: 用 gusto 造一個句子，描述你很投入、興致勃勃地做某件事。
referenceEn: I sang my favorite song with gusto at my sister's wedding.
I cleaned the whole house with gusto before the party.
rubricZh: gusto 是名詞，例如 with gusto、with great gusto 等，用來修飾動作
說的是自己做的事，時態配合內容（例如 sang、cleaned）
